responsibility: Handles customer login, logout, session creation, session validation and automatic expiration. Enforces active-session requirements for restricted areas (RF-01 to RF-04, RNF-32 to RNF-34, RNF-41). Backed by session persistence and validation logic derived from LoginREST and related session services.

Manages customer profiles, contact details, address, password confirmation for updates, access-control isolation between customers, and loyalty program query data (miles accumulated in year and total). Covers RF-19 to RF-27 and RNF-35, derived from CustomerREST and customer service/persistence classes.

Provides flight search by origin, destination and date, one-way and round-trip options, flight segment details, times, and reference prices, using the set of pre-registered airports. Covers RF-05 to RF-09 and RNF-37, derived from FlightsREST and flight service/persistence classes.

Manages creation of one-way and round-trip reservations, reservation identifier and date generation, listing existing reservations, and cancellation with consistency guarantees. Covers RF-10 to RF-18 and RNF-42, derived from BookingsREST and booking service classes.

Handles initial loading/reloading of the application database, configurable generation of example customers, recreation of core operational data (flights, customers, sessions, test bookings), and reporting of summary operating indicators (counts of customers, sessions, flights, segments, reservations, airports). Covers RF-28 to RF-31 and RNF-43, RNF-47, RNF-48, derived from LoaderREST, Loader and AcmeAirConfiguration.
